public class SDL_GPUIndexedIndirectDrawCommand extends Struct<SDL_GPUIndexedIndirectDrawCommand> implements NativeResource
struct SDL_GPUIndexedIndirectDrawCommand {
    Uint32 num_indices;
    Uint32 num_instances;
